### `packages/gp-api/src/chats/briefing-chats/services/briefingArtifactCache.service.ts:69` — catch block re-wraps S3 errors as 502, undoing this fix

The catch block in `briefingArtifactCache.service.ts` unconditionally re-throws every `s3Service.getFile` error as `BadGatewayException` (502), discarding the 500-vs-502 distinction this PR establishes in `aws.service.ts`.

`S3Service.getFile` is wrapped in `executeAwsOperation`, which already converts `ServiceException` errors to typed NestJS HTTP exceptions — including mapping `$fault: 'client'` errors (like the PermanentRedirect on the wrong-bucket row) to `InternalServerErrorException` (500). By the time any error reaches this catch, it is already a correctly-typed exception. Re-wrapping it as `BadGatewayException` tells the caller the failure is transient and worth retrying — which is exactly the 768-retries-per-week behavior the PR body says it is fixing.

The PR body claims the endpoint will answer 500 instead of 502 after this change, but `GET /v1/meetings/:date/briefing` goes through `briefingArtifactCache`, so callers will still see a retryable 502.

Fix: log and re-throw the already-typed exception:

```ts
try {
  body = await this.s3Service.getFile(bucket, key)
} catch (err) {
  this.logger.error(
    { err, bucket, key },
    'failed to fetch briefing artifact from S3',
  )
  throw err
}
```

### `ChiefOfStaffChatBody.test.tsx` — zero test coverage for `autoDictate`

The `autoDictate` effect — the only new behavior this PR ships — has zero test coverage. The happy path (`autoDictate=true, active=true` → `dictation.start` called once) and the reset path (`active` toggles to `false` → ref reset so the next open re-triggers) are both untested.

The test file also has no `vi.mock` for `useDictationAppend` — existing tests only pass because `autoDictate` defaults to `false`, so `start` is never reached. Any test that passes `autoDictate` without that mock will hit real browser APIs and fail in jsdom.

Add a `vi.mock` for `useDictationAppend` (see `AskAiChatBody.deferredCreate.test.tsx` for the pattern) and at minimum two tests: (1) `autoDictate=true, active=true` calls `dictation.start` once, (2) `active` false→true resets the guard and re-triggers.
